findings.evidence: Evidence-runner inconsistency missed in round 1: acceptance/evidence commands use `pytest` (stage-contract A1, A3, A4, A6; integration-plan E1-E3; tasks/T01.json and tasks/T03.json acceptance tests, e.g. 'pytest tests/test_rotation.py -q'), while the plan itself constrains the repo to stdlib-only ('no third-party imports anywhere in the change' — stage-contract constraints; 'Do not add third-party test dependencies (unittest + stdlib only)' — tasks/T03.json non_goals) and the existing suite is unittest (verified: tests/test_log.py). In an environment faithful to the plan's own constraints, pytest may not be installed, so several evidence commands would fail for environmental reasons rather than behavioral ones — a third party verifying A1/A3/A4/A6 could not run the evidence as written.
findings.suggested_fix: Swap the pytest invocations for the suite's actual runner, matching the existing style: 'python -m unittest tests.test_rotation -v', 'python -m unittest tests.test_log_rotation -v', 'python -m unittest tests.e2e.test_rotation_e2e -v' (or explicitly declare pytest an allowed runner in the contract constraints). Cheap, executor-discoverable in minutes; plan structure and criteria are unaffected.
